use liter_llm::BatchClient;

async fn main() {
    let request_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"document":{"type":"document_url","url":"https://example.com/contract-test.pdf"},"model":"mistral/mistral-ocr-latest"}"#).unwrap();
    let request = serde_json::from_value(request_json).unwrap();
    let client = liter_llm::create_client(std::env::var("API_KEY").expect("API_KEY must be set"), None, None, None, None).unwrap();
    let result = client.ocr(request).await;
    println!("{:?}", result);
